customerId.description: Client ID to invoice (required for create)

dueOffsetDays.description: Number of days until payment is due

taxName1.description: First tax name (must match a configured tax)

taxName2.description: Second tax name (must match a configured tax)

emailRecipients.description: Email addresses for sending (required for "send" action)

dateFrom.description: Filter invoices created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Filter invoices created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID to apply payment to (required for create)

emailRecipients.description: Email addresses for sending (required for "send" action)

clientId.description: Client ID to associate expense with

projectId.description: Project ID to associate expense with

dateFrom.description: Filter expenses on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Filter expenses on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp when work began (ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp)

billable.description: Whether this time is billable (default: true)

isLogged.description: Whether to stop the timer (true = stopped/logged, false = timer still running)

startedFrom.description: Filter entries started after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

startedTo.description: Filter entries started before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

compound.description: Whether this tax is compound (calculated on top of primary taxes)

currencyCode.description: Currency code for the unit cost
